# xlsx-tool

> Agent-friendly CLI for inspecting and editing XLSX workbooks.

Repository: https://github.com/evrenverse/xlsx-tool
License: MIT
Language: Go

## Start here

- README.md: installation, guarantees, and examples
- AGENTS.md: safe agent installation and contribution rules
- skills/xlsx-tool/SKILL.md: concise runtime workflow
- skills/xlsx-tool/references/cli.md: command examples
- SECURITY.md: trust model and vulnerability reporting
- CONTRIBUTING.md: development contract
- docs/agent-contract.md: versioned machine interface and exit behavior
- docs/architecture.md: component and trust-boundary overview
- evals/README.md: reproducible locate-edit-verify evaluation

## CLI

Install with:

    go install github.com/evrenverse/xlsx-tool/cmd/xlsx-tool@latest

Discover exact syntax with:

    xlsx-tool --help
    xlsx-tool <command> --help
    xlsx-tool capabilities --json
    xlsx-tool doctor --json
    xlsx-tool schema
